Global Leaders Undergraduate Scholarship

The Global Leaders Undergraduate Scholarship provides substantial financial support to high-achieving undergraduate students.

Award Details

Recipients receive an annual award of $25,000 per year toward tuition expenses. The scholarship is renewable up to four years provided the student maintains academic standing.

Eligibility Requirements

  • International students are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Applicants must have a minimum GPA of 3.8 on a 4.0 scale.
  • Submission of SAT is required for all candidates.
  • CSS Profile is required to evaluate eligibility for supplementary aid.

Important Deadlines

The final scholarship application deadline is January 15, 2026. Early Action candidates must apply by November 1, 2025.
